# Japanese Chefs Knife

> > The premier online destination for 1500+ authentic Japanese chef knives from legendary makers like Masamoto, Misono, Hattori, and Kanetsugu, with worldwide shipping via FedEx and DHL.

Japanese Chefs Knife specializes in curated collections of traditional and modern Japanese kitchen knives, featuring both established heritage brands with centuries of craftsmanship and exclusive JCK Original lines. The site serves professional chefs and enthusiasts seeking authentic wa-bocho and gyuto knives with detailed product catalogs and customer support.

## Exclusive JCK Original Collections

- [JCK Original 輝 KAGAYAKI](https://japanesechefsknife.com/collections/jck-original-kagayaki): JCK Original Kagayaki brand knives crafted with Japanese craftsmen
- [JCK Original 風林火山 Fu-Rin-Ka-Zan](https://japanesechefsknife.com/collections/jck-original-fu-rin-ka-zan): Traditional wa-bocho hand forged by Japan's top blacksmiths
- [Premium Knife Collections | 刀神 Syojin](https://japanesechefsknife.com/collections/premium-syojin): Premium Syojin artisan knife collection with gyuto, santoku, yanagiba
- [JCK Natures](https://japanesechefsknife.com/collections/jck-natures): JCK Natures fusion of craftsmen technology and natural scenery

## Premium Japanese Knife Brands

- [Masamoto-Sohonten](https://japanesechefsknife.com/collections/masamoto): Masamoto-Sohonten: 150+ years of professional sushi chef knives
- [Misono Knives](https://japanesechefsknife.com/collections/misono): Misono leading Seki-city knives with 800 years blade smithing
- [Premium Knife Maker Hattori](https://japanesechefsknife.com/collections/hattori): Hattori premium knives: 50+ years of quality craftsmanship
- [Kanetsugu Knives](https://japanesechefsknife.com/collections/kanetsugu): Kanetsugu Seki knives with 800 years of sword making heritage
- [Shirou-Kunimitsu 四郎國光 Japanese Knives](https://japanesechefsknife.com/collections/shirou-kunimitsu): Shirou-Kunimitsu: 200+ years of family sword smithing tradition
